programs.title: The Admirable Crichton
programs.desc: Comedy. Kenneth More stars as the perfect butler, who assumes command when he, his aristocratic employer (Cecil Parker) and his family and friends are shipwrecked on a desert island.

programs.title: The Frogmen
programs.desc: Second World War thriller. Richard Widmark, Dana Andrews and Robert Wagner star as divers with a special underwater demolition team taking the war to the Japanese in the Pacific.

programs.title: The Man from Colorado
programs.desc: Western. When a sadistic Union colonel (Glenn Ford) becomes a federal judge after the Civil War, his friend (William Holden) takes the deputy job to try and temper his actions.

programs.title: Anzio
programs.desc: Epic Second World War drama starring Robert Mitchum. A reporter gets trapped behind enemy lines during the costly 1944 Allied invasion of Italy. With Peter Falk and Robert Ryan.

programs.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programs.desc: Fact-based crime biopic starring Robert Redford and Sissy Spacek. Charming 74-year-old bank robber Forrest Tucker falls for an enchanting farmer. But is he ready to retire.

programs.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programs.desc: Sci-fi action sequel with Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. A factory worker is targeted by deadly robot assassins from the future. Thank goodness he's back.

programs.title: New Life
programs.desc: John Rosman's pestilential horror about a young woman running from something that she, perhaps, cannot escape, and the older woman chasing her. Starring Hayley Erin and Sonya Walger.

programs.title: Hotel Splendide
programs.desc: Drama. A woman (Toni Collette) returns to Hotel Splendide, where she used to work as a chef, hoping to rekindle her romance with the hotel owner's son (Daniel Craig). Sexual scenes.

programs.title: Sign of the Pagan
programs.desc: Jack Palance plays Attila the Hun, sweeping across Europe with his hordes and conquering all before him, with Jeff Chandler as the Roman general charged with saving the Empire.

programs.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programs.desc: Robert Wagner stars as the infamous outlaw in Nicholas Ray's western, which follows the last 18 years of the robber's life.
